historical_core.code_unit: five ordered binary positions over a/b per plaintext letter class
historical_core.segmentation: 5 positions per hidden-letter class; decoder must know the starting phase
historical_core.inverse: partition the synchronized a/b stream into consecutive 5-position groups and invert the unique table codeword
historical_core.recoverability: EXACT_24_CLASS_LETTER_STREAM_WITH_5_POSITION_SYNCHRONIZATION; I/J AND U/V ARE NOT DISTINCT; HIDDEN SPACES/PUNCTUATION ARE NOT ENCODED BY THE TABLE

authorities.work: Francis Bacon, De dignitate et augmentis scientiarum
authorities.note: The 1623 work is the primary historical source for the biliteral/omnia-per-omnia mechanism.

authorities.work: Gilbert Wats translation of De Augmentis Scientiarum
authorities.note: States the five-place two-letter construction, 24-letter alphabet, bi-formed exterior carrier, and the historical FUGE example.
Reproduces the 24-entry biliteral table and states that a bi-formed exterior alphabet carries a/b letter-for-letter.

carrier_rule.historical_property: The interior a/b stream is carried letter-for-letter by an exterior stream whose objects have two distinguishable forms; the exterior message/content may otherwise be chosen independently.
carrier_rule.minimum_capacity_relation: at least five exterior positions per hidden letter
carrier_rule.surface_prediction_problem: The mechanism does not determine the exterior base-letter/object sequence, its word boundaries, lineation, paragraph structure, recurrence, inventory, or other surface organization. Those can be imported by the chosen carrier.

reasons: The historically visible bi-formed carrier requires a choice of exterior carrier identities/content that is not fixed by the biliteral cipher.
Mapping Voynich glyphs or tokens into the a-form versus b-form would require an externally unlicensed binary partition unless independently documented before target inspection.
Using literal a/b as the overt surface would expose the analytical interior labels rather than Bacon's bi-formed carrier and still supplies no historically visible word boundary every five bits.
Treating each 5-bit hidden-letter group as a Voynich-like visible bounded unit would introduce analyst boundaries that the historical carrier need not display.
Allowing arbitrary carrier choice would let R1-R8 structure be imported through the carrier rather than predicted by B1623-BL0 itself.
relevant_contract_facts: R1 is defined on candidate-visible boundaries.
R2 is defined on candidate token-internal surface construction under the frozen SlotParser representation.
R5-R8 require a single immutable candidate surface/hierarchy rather than an arbitrary post-hoc carrier.

the two-form classifier/alphabet defining a-form versus b-form for every exterior object
any mapping from historical exterior forms to target surface atoms
r10.consequence: Because the carrier is an independent high-capacity surface channel, it cannot be treated as free or chosen from target resemblance.
